answer.summary: The ensure-no-git-diff step failed because the committed AddTenantIdToExecutionTracesMigrationTest.java is not formatted the way the build's formatter wants. The diff wraps two @DisplayName annotations onto multiple lines, so the working tree differs from the commit. This is deterministic and tied to this PR's test file, so a re-run will fail the same way. Fix: run the formatter on the file and commit the result.
